verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an auth framework, for example batch user bans, role changes or session revocation, but nothing in the evidence documents a bulk or batch capability. The admin plugin describes operations on individual users, and the Auth0 migration script is a one-off import belonging to a different (migration) story, so neither counts here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
